title: Ice Skating in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Rinks open weeks apart.** The Sportforum hall in Hohenschönhausen plans to start on **12 October**, Winterquartier at Ostkreuz on **6 November**.
**Horst-Dohm and Lankwitz are expected in November;** Neukölln and Erika-Heß have no 2026/27 date yet.
**Indoor halls run in any weather.** Outdoor rinks close when warm rain turns the ice to slush.
**City rinks cost 4 euros, 2 reduced.** Erika-Heß and Lankwitz charge 7, Winterquartier 6 to 9.50 by slot.
**Budget for skate hire:** 7 euros at the Sportforum and Lankwitz, 5 at Winterquartier.
**Weekend tickets at the Sportforum and all Winterquartier slots are sold online,** so book before you set off.
**Frozen lakes are never officially released.** The water police say anyone on the ice is there at their own risk.
